idea-plugin.name: libSQL / Turso
idea-plugin.description:
libSQL / Turso Database Driver for DataGrip

Native JDBC driver that connects DataGrip to libSQL and Turso databases via the HTTP pipeline API. No external dependencies — just install and connect.

Features

  • Full schema introspection — tables, columns, primary keys, indexes, and foreign keys in the database tree
  • Proper query lifecycle — no hanging spinners (fixes the DBeaver driver issue)
  • SQLite dialect — full SQL completion and syntax highlighting
  • Turso Cloud ready — paste your JWT auth token in the Password field
  • Zero config — auto-registers in DataGrip's driver list on install
  • Clear error messages — auth failures (401/403) surfaced with actionable guidance

Getting Started

  1. Install this plugin and restart DataGrip
  2. Add a new Data Source → select libSQL / Turso
  3. Enter your Turso database host (e.g. my-db.turso.io)
  4. Paste your Turso JWT auth token in the Password field
  5. Test Connection

Supported Databases

  • Turso Cloud databases
  • Self-hosted libSQL servers (sqld)
  • Local libSQL instances

Source code: github.com/dot-inc/datagrip-libsql

Report issues: GitHub Issues
